item.title: Tyler, the Creator Blows Himself Up at the 2026 Grammys
item.description: The rapper is up for six awards, including Album of the Year and Best Rap Album for his LP Chromakopia

item.title: Billie Eilish Slams ICE During Song of the Year Speech: ‘No One Is Illegal on Stolen Land’
item.description: The singer-songwriter won the award for "Wildflower" and took the opportunity to encourage people to protest

item.title: Bad Bunny, Natalia Lafourcade, And All the Grammy Wins for Latin Artists So Far
item.description: Ca7riel and Paco Amoroso scored Best Latin Rock or Alternative Album, while Gloria Estefan won for Best Tropical Album

item.title: Brian Wilson, Bob Weir, D’Angelo Honored at Grammys In Memoriam Segment
item.description: Post Malone saluted Ozzy Osbourne with a star-studded backing band, while Lauryn Hill made her first Grammys performance since 1999

item.title: ICE Out at the Grammys: Bad Bunny, Billie Eilish, SZA, Olivia Dean Speak Out
item.description: Justin Bieber, Brandi Carlile, Jack Antonoff, and more also showed up sporting "ICE Out" pins in protest of the Trump admin's immigration crackdown

item.title: Cher Accepts Lifetime Achievement Award in Surprise Appearance at 2026 Grammy Awards
item.description: "What I want to tell you," Cher said, "never give up on your dream, no matter what happens. Live it, be it, and if it's not happening now, it will happen soon"

item.title: Kendrick Lamar, SZA Win Record of the Year for ‘Luther’ at 2026 Grammys
item.description: "Luther Vandross is one of my favorite artists of all time," Kendrick Lamar says

item.title: Clipse, Pharrell Williams Make It Snow During Heavenly Grammys Performance
item.description: Pusha T and Malice, joined by superstar producer, made their long-overdue Grammy debut with "So Far Ahead"

item.title: Grammys 2026: The Best, Worst, and Most WTF Moments
item.description: Bad Bunny was the star of the night, but there were also lots of other incredible performances, and a few curveballs

item.title: Bad Bunny Makes History with Album of the Year Win
item.description: His sprawling Debi Tirar Mas Fotos is the first fully Spanish-language album LP to win the prize
